parsed.rationale: Both records are unnamed extensions (name: "") with empty fields_or_signature lists, making it impossible to determine whether they extend AVAudioSession for the same purpose or for entirely unrelated reasons. The cluster carries no structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, and shared_ancestor are all null), and the two packages — Playback (Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/AudioSessionProtocol.swift) and PartyHorn (Shared/PartyHorn/Sources/PartyHorn/SoundPlayer.swift) — serve distinct domain concerns (audio session protocol plumbing vs. sound playback). Without member-level evidence, any consolidation recommendation would be speculative and potentially harmful.
